thread:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: P0 Pager — DB connection leak + elevated 5xx rate after release/2026-03-15-1742. Affected service: inference-api-canary. Alert: https://redwood.monitor/alerts/8231

sre-oncall: I got the page, taking this. Can someone confirm whether the canary rollback auto-policy was hit?

deploy-bot: Auto-rollback did not run — deployment status: Canary failed healthchecks but migration job status = "completed" and flag auto_rollback=false for migration jobs. See deploy ID: deploy-2026-03-15-1742 (canary 2/3 unhealthy).

maria: that's my deploy, fyi. I ran the DB migration earlier, it was supposed to be back-compatible but I think we missed an index+not-null that caused long-running statements on replicas. Sorry, on it.

ashok: ok first-order: stop sending traffic to canary, toggle kill-switch for the feature if that's possible. If migration touched writes that are incompatible, feature flag might not help.

jamie: support, any customer reports / severity?

olivia-support: Support queue has ~12 customers reporting elevated latency/500s. Top affected: AcmeCorp (prod), ByteShop (prod). Errors are 503s and connection timeouts. Ticket links: https://support.redwood/incs/5543

sre-oncall: plan proposal — we can't rely on automatic rollback because migration left DB in a state causing connections to hang. Options:
1) feature-flag kill-switch to stop new code paths (if safe)
2) manual rollback of service to previous image + drain connections
3) attempt immediate reverse migration (risky without sequence)

maria: kill-switch won't fully revert behavior because background worker picks up new DB rows with schema change. safer path is manual rollback + migration reverse if needed.

ashok: I'm going to coordinate the manual rollback. Steps I'm about to do:

```
# mark canary out of service and start rollback
redwoodctl feature-flag set db_migration_new_schema false --scope=global
kubectl -n production scale deployment inference-canary --replicas=0
# rollback rollout to previous stable revision
kubectl -n production rollout undo deployment/inference --to-revision=42
# check rollout status
kubectl -n production rollout status deployment/inference --watch
```

ashok: also will put write endpoints in maintenance (short window) to drain active connections on primary.

maria: prepping reverse migration script, but note: reverse requires downtime to avoid split-brain writes. I'll stand by to run reverse once rollback is confirmed.

deploy-bot: Initiating controlled rollback: deploy-rollback job queued by ashok. Watch logs: https://deploy.redwood/logs/deploy-rollback-1766001240

sre-oncall: verification checklist after rollback — everyone confirm when done:
- 503 rate back to < 0.1%
- open DB connections below baseline (< 200)
- p50/p95 latency within normal ranges
- no new migration jobs running
- customer-facing errors cleared in support queue

olivia-support: updating affected customers with ETA ~20m. Tagging AcmeCorp + ByteShop now.

ashok: beginning rollback now. Monitoring metrics: https://grafana.redwood/d/infra/inference-overview

(5m later)

ashok: rollback hit a kube-pod stuck terminating because of long-lived DB conn. Forcing container kill.

maria: running reverse migration checklist — taking DB read-only for writes, running rollback script.

```
-- DB checks
SELECT count(*) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE state <> 'idle';
-- run rollback script
psql $PRIMARY_DB -f /migrations/2026-03-15-reverse.sql
```

(sre-oncall) 10: I see connections dropping, CPU on primary returning to normal, 5xx rate dropping from 4.2% -> 0.6%

olivia-support: support queue: reduced to 3 active customer tickets (AcmeCorp now in monitoring).

jamie: timeline note: page at 1766001234, rollback started ~1766001300, partial recovery signals at 1766001500.

maria: reverse migration applied. Confirmed no pending migrations and schema matches stable.

ashok: completed deployment rollback, rollout status green. Verifying app logs for errors:
```
kubectl -n production logs -l app=inference --tail=200 | grep -i error
```
No new errors after rollback.

sre-oncall: final checks: p95 latency back to normal, open DB connections 172, 5xx ~0.05%. Marking incident mitigated.

maria: really sorry for the disruption — will open a postmortem and hold on-call blameless.

jamie: handing over to night-sre for monitoring. @sre-night please take over at 1766001600.

sre-oncall: handing off — all runbooks executed, rollback complete, customers notified. Please escalate if anything regresses.

olivia-support: customers updated: AcmeCorp escalated to B, ByteShop acknowledged. No major data loss reported.

deploy-bot: deploy-rollback job finished: success (duration 12m).

sre-oncall: incident mitigated. Please create postmortem and include: why migration was non-backwards-compatible, why auto-rollback didn't trigger, and whether feature flags can be improved. Assign owners: maria (r), ashok (ops), jamie (customers).

maria: creating postmortem now — will attach timeline and commands used. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
